Overview

The hidden cost of Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Healthcare & Life Sciences is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on EHR integration, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. What makes Healthcare & Life Sciences different is not the math; it is the operating context: HIPAA / HITECH governs the data, clinical reality governs the economics, and the people accountable for outcomes answer to regulators as well as customers. Every design choice below is downstream of that context.
